rationale: C13 is the clear drafting template. It has the identical title and reproduces the same three-item list of statutory provisions whose operation affects the appointments. The child evidently renews or extends the same appointment-continuation mechanism with updated dates and eligibility conditions. C10 shares only a general deadline-extension device, while C16 concerns the armed forces but supplies no comparable operative text.

shared_material.parent_excerpt: continuing effect certain appointments officers and warrant officers
shared_material.explanation: The identical, highly specific title identifies the same administrative action.
